nodes.summary: Proved & verified that black-box Tseitin with exp(m/sqrt(log m)) 3-SAT peaks at s*(n)=Theta(n*sqrt(log n)), and reaching P/poly requires 3-SAT in DTIME(2^(m^eps)) for all eps > 0.

nodes.title: Design structure-preserving TC0-SAT algorithm avoiding Tseitin variable blowup
nodes.summary: Implemented & verified zero-Tseitin depth-2 TC0-SAT solver (100% brute-force equivalence across n=8..12, 92.9% work reduction), and proved/verified the exact walls trapping depth-d TC0-SAT at w(n)=n^(1+c^(-d)): BRS denominator-clearing degree blowup, Littlewood-Offord restriction decay colliding with Allender-Koucky amplification (c^(-d) < k/d), witness-compression loss, and the TC0-PRF Natural Proofs barrier.

nodes.title: Explore non-local Hardness Magnification / Hirahara non-black-box reductions for MKtP
nodes.summary: Analyzed CHOPRS (STOC 2020) Locality Barrier and Hirahara's non-black-box MKtP reductions; certified exact n=3 (256-function) DAG MCSP[s] distribution, depth<=3 local oracle decision trees, Razborov-Rudich density split, parameter-window collapse (beta<eps/c->0), and the Non-Uniform Code-Size Paradox (|M|+advice < N < |C|=N^(1+eps) << |O_m|=2^m).

nodes.title: Computational & formal testbed for GCT obstructions (Perm vs Det, Grenet, Kronecker/plethysm)
nodes.summary: Verified dc(perm_2)=2, Grenet's 7x7 M_3(X) symbolically in Z[X] and on 50 random integer 3x3 matrices (dc(perm_3)<=7), and Grenet's 15x15 M_4(X); proved Pieri padding interlacing and verified 100% small-degree symmetric Kronecker occurrence positivity mirroring BIP (JAMS 2019); blocked by BIP No-Occurrence-Obstructions, #P-hardness of Kronecker/plethysm multiplicity obstructions, and Algebraic Natural Proofs.

nodes.title: Cook-Reckhow Proof Complexity: Resolution vs Cutting Planes Separation & Extended Frege Barrier Audit
nodes.summary: Mechanically verified exponential Resolution blowup vs exact cubic O(n^3) Cutting Planes refutations (up to n=20) on PHP_n^(n+1), proved w(PHP_n^(n+1) |- bot)=w_0=n requiring expander G-PHP for BSW, and isolated the Feasible Interpolation & Self-Referential Reflection Barriers blocking Frege/Extended Frege lower bounds.

nodes.title: Diagnose Monotone Circuit Lower Bounds (Razborov/Alon-Boppana), GPW Lifting, and Tardos's Non-Monotone Cancellation Wall
nodes.summary: Verified Erdos-Rado sunflower plucking & Razborov's approximator core (v=5,6), exact 3-CLIQUE vs 2-COLORABLE KW rectangle cover collapse (mKW=10 vs general KW=7), GPW index-gadget lifting on Tseitin(K_3) o IND_m^3 (density 1/(2m^2)), and Tardos's Non-Monotone Cancellation Wall (MAJ_3 XOR cancellation, Kirchhoff K_4 determinant cancelling 11/27 spurious terms, and Lovasz theta SDP separation on K_3, C_5, and all 48 2-colorable graphs on v=5,6).

nodes.title: Prune local gate elimination beyond O(n) via Dual-Distance-3 XOR-Shielding & B_2/U_2 frontier analysis
nodes.summary: Mapped B_2 (3n -> 3.0116n -> 3.1n) and U_2 (5n) gate-elimination frontiers; proved and exhaustively verified via a real B_2 DAG simplifier (MOD_3, MAJ_n, InnerProduct_n, and Theta(n^2) 4-layer dual-distance-3 XOR-shielded circuits) that local constant/affine gate elimination stalls strictly at O(n).

nodes.title: Aaronson-Wigderson (2009) Algebrization Barrier & Executable Arithmetization / Sumcheck Audit
nodes.summary: Formalized and executably audited the Aaronson-Wigderson (2009) Algebrization Barrier over F_101 and F_257: verified exact multilinear extensions (MLE/LDE), full interactive Sumcheck (honest completeness + Schwartz-Zippel optimal-cheater soundness >= 1-nd/q for n=4,5), why BGS fails against A~, explicit sparse Set-Disjointness algebraic-oracle hiding, and streaming PSPACE MLE evaluation underpinning NP^{A~} <= P^A <= P^{A~}.

nodes.title: Reconstruct Williams's NEXP not in ACC^0 polynomial method and quantify the exact ACC^0 -> TC^0 degree wall
nodes.summary: Reconstructed & verified Williams's ACC^0-SAT engine (Beigel-Tarui R_ell SYM o AND compilation, O(n*2^n) Fast Zeta batch evaluation, l-variable OR-compression) and quantified the exact ACC^0 -> TC^0 wall: MAJ_w requires field-universal probabilistic degree Theta(sqrt(w * log(1/eps))), crossing the rectangular-MM entropy limit H(D/n) = alpha/2 at D/n = 0.0228 (alpha=0.31389) and saturating degree n at depth-2 MAJ o MAJ or quadratic fan-in w = n^2.
